subject: Re: Instrumentation bundle economics & prorate mechanics (proposal inside)
messages:
From: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cobaltlabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cobaltlabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Telemetry add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing and pilot mechanics

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Cobalt's team was encouraged by the latency numbers. We're trying to close internal procurement next quarter and need clear economics for the add-ons: extended retention (30/90/365 days), distributed tracing sampling, and the advanced dashboard pack. Specifically:

- A sample pricing table for each retention bucket and tracing sampling tier (tokens/month equivalence is fine)
- How pilot credits are applied and whether billing is prorated during ramp months
- If there's an option to convert pilot credits into an upfront prepay discount on an annual commitment

Attached is our short RFP and expected ingestion profile. Can you share a recommended packaging that keeps our first 3 months low-friction while giving us predictable unit cost after month 4?

[attachment: Cobalt_Telemetry_RFP.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Appreciate a concise option set so our finance and platform teams can sign off.

Best,
Morgan Reyes
Head of Platform Engineering
Cobalt Labs

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cobaltlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@cobaltlabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing and pilot mechanics

Morgan — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. Looping in Laura (commercial lead) and Ben (solutions) to propose a tight set of options. Quick summary below so you can share with finance: 

Option 1 — Pilot-first, monthly pay-as-you-go
- 3-month pilot: 100k token credits for retention + 50k token credits for tracing sampling, included at no charge
- Post-pilot: standard add-on rates (example: 30d retention = $0.00045/token-month; 90d = $0.00065; 365d = $0.00095)
- Billing: pilot credits consumed first; first paid month prorated by actual days in production

Option 2 — Pilot -> Annual prepay (preferred economics)
- 3-month pilot as above, then annual prepay for add-ons with a tiered discount (5% at $150k ARR equivalent, 12% at $300k, 18% at $600k)
- Pilot credits applied as a one-time credit against the annual invoice (not double-billed)

Option 3 — Commit & Save (best unit cost)
- Commit to a 12-month add-on minimum for a blended rate (example blended retention rate $0.00072/token-month) and include extended support SLA and 1 additional dashboard seat

We can sketch exact numbers once Ben confirms your ingestion velocity in the spreadsheet you attached. Laura — if we accept a 3-month pilot + prepay conversion, do we want to standardize the prorate wording to keep legal happy (short-term termination provisions)?

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call with finance tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cobaltlabs.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@cobaltlabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons: pricing tiers, proration & SOW

Hi Morgan — following up with a compact pricing matrix and the standard SOW template attached. Below are the concrete line items we suggest given your ingestion profile: 

Retention (tokens/month equivalent):
- 30d: $0.00045/token-month
- 90d: $0.00063/token-month
- 365d: $0.00090/token-month

Tracing (sampled traces / month):
- Basic (1% sampling): $900/mo flat
- Production (5% sampling): $3,600/mo flat
- High-fidelity (10%+): custom pricing (depends on trace cardinality)

Advanced Dashboards Pack:
- Add-on $1,800/mo per workspace + $250 per additional seat after 5 seats

Prorate & Pilot mechanics (recommended wording):
- Pilot credits are consumed first and will be reflected as a credit on the first paid invoice post-pilot.
- Any month where production usage begins will be billed pro rata for the portion of the calendar month used.
- If customer converts pilot into an annual prepay within 30 days of pilot end, pilot credits will be applied against the prepay invoice.

I've attached the tier sheet and a redline-ready SOW. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference so our finance and CSM teams are aligned.

[attachment: Cobalt_Telemetry_Tiers.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
[attachment: SOW-template.docx (DOCX, 80KB)]

Link: https://hubspot.com/deals/COB-8372

Let me know if your procurement team needs an explicit termination-for-convenience clause for the pilot period; we can include a 30-day notice and limit the customer's liability to consumed usage.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cobaltlabs.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cobaltlabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons: pricing tiers, proration & SOW

Thanks Laura — that matrix is exactly what finance and procurement need. A couple of clarifications from our side after reviewing with ops and finance: 

1) Pilot structure: we want a three-month pilot but with a hard cap on spend for month 1 (to prove the instrumentation) and then allow usage-based billing in months 2-3. Can you reflect a $10k cap on month 1 and then the remaining pilot credits for months 2-3?
2) Proration: good to see prorate by calendar days. Can you confirm that prorated month 1 charges will be billed net of pilot cap/credits (i.e., we won't see separate invoices overlapping)?
3) Prepay discount: we like Option 2 but request the 12% discount threshold reduce to $250k ARR equivalent instead of $300k (our CFO expects to sign against that band)

If you can agree to the month-1 cap and the adjusted discount breakpoint we'll route this through procurement next week. We'll also need your finance contact for the prepay invoicing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Morgan

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cobaltlabs.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-02T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons: pricing tiers, proration & SOW (final concession proposal)

Morgan — thanks, and sorry for the short pause while we firmed up the legal/finance wording. We can accommodate the items below: 

Agreed concessions:
- Month 1 hard cap: $10,000 (consumption beyond cap will be paused and flagged for approval)
- Pilot credits: 100k retention tokens + 50k tracing tokens; credits apply first and show as a single credit on the first paid invoice.
- Proration: prorated billing for partial-production months; invoice will net pilot credits so there is no double-billing.
- Prepay discount breakpoint: lowered to $250k ARR equivalent for the 12% tier (as requested)

Commercial mechanics & contract notes:
- We'll provide a short amendment to the MSA/SOW that includes a 30-day pilot termination notice with liability limited to consumed usage. Draft amendment attached.
- If you sign and prepay within 30 days after pilot end, we'll apply pilot credits against the prepaid invoice and reflect the final discount.

Next steps:
1) I'll upload the amendment to DocuSign by EOD tomorrow: https://docusign.com/packet/AMEND-COB8372
2) Finance contact: payments@redwood.ai — cc me and Laura on the wire instructions so we can expedite.
3) Operational kickoff: I'll schedule a 45-min tech onboarding with Ben (solutions) and your platform team next week.

[attachment: amendment-pilot-credit-COB8372.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

If that aligns, please confirm and we'll generate the DocuSign packet. Happy to adjust any narrow legal wording but the commercial structure above is firm.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
